_help: Tap coordinates for the Grow a Garden 2 mail flow on the Android/Waydroid screen. Run 'python3 scripts/calibrate.py' to set these interactively.
_flow_summary: 1. Tap mailbox object in-game → context menu appears
2. Tap 'Mailbox View' in the context menu
4. Username search field appears → type recipient username
5. Tap the player from the autocomplete list (first result)
6. Inventory grid appears → tap the item to send

mailbox_object._help: The physical mailbox object in the game world (you walk up to it and tap it)

mailbox_view_option._help: The 'Mailbox View' option in the context menu that appears after tapping the mailbox

mail_button._help: The 'Mail' button inside the Your Mailbox panel (bottom of the panel)

username_search_field._help: The username search/input field where you type the recipient's name

first_search_result._help: The first player result in the autocomplete list (the bot always picks the first one after typing the full username)

send_button._help: The green 'Send' button on the inventory/compose screen

close_button._help: The X / Close button to dismiss the mailbox panel after sending (set enabled:false to skip)

inventory_scroll_area._help: A point inside the inventory item grid used as the scroll target. Set during calibration.

_item_templates_help: For each item you sell, save a small PNG crop of its icon from the inventory grid into assets/ui-templates/items/<ItemName>.png. The delivery script uses OpenCV to find and tap the correct item.

timings._help: Milliseconds to wait after each action for animations to finish
